summary: Four-column packing is usable for separating candidate artwork. The 2K sample retains source3 floor count where 1K invents one floor, but neither is geometry-accepted. Continuous panorama preserves broad perspective and roof masses while simplifying visible details. No game rollout.

findings.single0: Broad opening count retained; facade widened to fill 9:16 instead of white padding, opaque white glass, altered trim.
findings.single80: Main gable, attic pair and three balcony levels retained; invented flanking buildings, widened framing and reconstructed obscured shop.
findings.sheet1k: Four columns remain separable at original horizontal coordinates. Source3 has five upper opening rows instead of four, upward-expanded roof/mast and brighter orange masonry. Source0,4,80 broad opening rhythms retained; ground details idealized.
findings.sheet2k: Four columns remain separable. Source3 has correct four upper rows, but masonry bands/trim still changed. Extra drawn grid lines, source4 brick pattern despite no-texture prompt, neutral ground occlusions; no exact registration established.
findings.panorama1k: One continuous real panorama-derived context crop, not packed images. Broad roofline and receding street perspective retained; right-side inset balconies reduced to blank recesses, ground occlusions flattened and some doors reconstructed. Context-zone cuts are not verified per-building boundaries.

limitations: One sample per condition; resolution effect not statistically isolated from generation randomness.
Both sheets use identical 1024-square input. 2K output does not recover additional source pixels.
Single controls use 9:16 framing suffix; Pro lacks the narrower source aspect. Explicit pre-padding would improve control design.
Prompt asks flat colours without texture. This does not evaluate brick-texture synthesis quality.
Earlier Lite used bespoke prompts; this Pro trial uses a generic prompt, so no controlled Pro/Lite winner.
next: Use 2K four-facade packs for the next small held-out comparison, with explicit padded single controls and fixed geometry overlays. Keep continuous panoramas as context; isolate and rectify each frontage before production textures.
independentReviewer: Sol visual review confirms source3 extra floor at1K, correct count at2K; all columns remain separate; panorama preserves broad roofline but regularizes distant/hidden geometry.
